1_requirements.notes: Interactive interview with the user (11 areas, incl. 10-platform-and-deployment: target engine & portability, dbt, Terraform/IaC, CI/CD), then write <workspace>/requirements/*.md

2_architecture.notes: Reads phase 1 output, writes <workspace>/design/*.md incl. mermaid diagrams, transformation-design.md (dbt) and deployment-and-iac.md (Terraform + CI/CD)

3_build_and_test.notes: Scaffold components + the dbt project (models, snapshots, tests) with unit tests against fixtures

4_pipeline_and_git.notes: Orchestrator pipelines + Terraform modules per env + CI/CD (plan/apply + dbt build) + repo push

5_full_testing_and_hardening.notes: Integration/contract tests, CI gates, drift detection, observability, security review, backfill + rollback drills
